Even after reaching the endgame, you can easily take a long break and jump back in whenever you feel like it

Since most maps are procedurally generated, their layouts change with every run, making even familiar missions feel slightly different each time
While the core mission types can become repetitive, Digital Extremes regularly introduces new game modes and mechanics to keep things fresh
Another major highlight is the incredible variety of Warframes, weapons, and modifications
This freedom is a huge part of what makes Warframe so enjoyable to me

核心循环为：接取行动（潜入戒备森严的建筑、提取或破坏数据）→ 运用黑客工具箱化解威胁 → 完成任务 → 累积"粉丝（Followers）"→ 解锁更强力、更远程的黑客能力
- 黑客工具箱：智能手机远程入侵（红绿灯、摄像头、ctOS 联网设备）、四轴无人机（高空侦察 / 标记）、RC Jumper 跳跳车（狭小空间潜入）、环境陷阱（爆炸管道、叉车、吊车）与社会工程

- Windows 11 24H2 启动异常、现代 Core i9 的 E-core 调度问题（可用 Process Lasso 仅保留 P-core）等亦见报告
- 综合来看：本作在"能跑"的旧硬件上体验稳定，但在新 GPU / 新系统上需手动调校，门槛主要体现为兼容性问题而非性能不足
